metadata.title: Freight Logistics Orchestration Data Assets
metadata.description: Starter catalog of key business, operational, financial, compliance, and sensitive data assets for the freight logistics orchestration domain.

rootGroups.name: People, Accounts, and Access Data
rootGroups.description: Profiles, accounts, credentials, consent, entitlements, and access records used to identify people and govern their access.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Shipper Account
assets.description: Shipper organization, users, contracts, billing setup, service policies, facilities, and integration profile.
assets.accessScope: shipper portal, TMS, billing, support, and integrations
assets.businessMeaning: Source of truth for shipper eligibility, commercial terms, operating policies, and user access.

interfaces.name: shipper-account api
interfaces.description: Access interface for shipper account and policy data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to shipper, operations, finance, and support workflows

assets.name: Carrier Profile
assets.description: Carrier identity, authority, insurance, safety, equipment, contacts, bank, tax, compliance, and operating preferences.
assets.accessScope: carrier onboarding, matching, booking, tracking, payment, risk, and support
assets.businessMeaning: Core supply-side identity and eligibility data for freight execution and settlement.

interfaces.name: carrier-profile api
interfaces.description: Access interface for carrier eligibility and profile data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to capacity, compliance, payment, and operations workflows

assets.name: Carrier Performance Record
assets.description: Scored on-time, acceptance, claims, and service-quality history per carrier, aggregated across shipments and lanes.
assets.accessScope: carrier scorecards, matching, procurement, and operations workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Basis for carrier selection, routing-guide placement, and quality interventions.

interfaces.name: carrier-performance api
interfaces.description: Access interface for carrier performance record data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to procurement, operations, and the scored carrier

assets.name: Carrier Preference Profile
assets.description: Carrier-declared lane preferences, equipment availability, operating regions, and load-acceptance constraints.
assets.accessScope: carrier app, matching engine, and capacity planning
assets.businessMeaning: Lets matching and tendering respect where carriers actually want to run.

interfaces.name: carrier-preference api
interfaces.description: Access interface for carrier preference profile data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to matching, tendering, and carrier support workflows

assets.name: Facility Profile
assets.description: Warehouse, dock, and yard attributes with operating hours, appointment rules, and observed dwell-time intelligence.
assets.accessScope: planning, scheduling, tracking, and carrier-facing apps
assets.businessMeaning: Shared facility truth that drives realistic appointments, ETAs, and detention decisions.

interfaces.name: facility-profile api
interfaces.description: Access interface for facility profile data.

governance.retention: while facility is active plus 24 months
governance.sharingPolicy: shared across shipper, carrier, and operations workflows

rootGroups.name: Commercial and Financial Data
rootGroups.description: Pricing, payment, billing, subscription, revenue, settlement, ledger, and other commercial records.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Contract Rate
assets.description: Awarded lane rates, fuel rules, accessorial terms, routing guide commitments, mode rules, and effective dates.
assets.accessScope: procurement, tendering, quoting, audit, and settlement
assets.businessMeaning: Commercial source for pricing, routing guide, and invoice validation decisions.

interfaces.name: contract-rate api
interfaces.description: Access interface for active and historical rate terms.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted by customer, carrier, and commercial role

assets.name: Shipper Network Model
assets.description: Modeled lanes, volumes, service requirements, and network scenarios for a shipper's freight network design.
assets.accessScope: network planning workspace and procurement events
assets.businessMeaning: Working model behind network design, bid preparation, and what-if scenario analysis.

interfaces.name: shipper-network api
interfaces.description: Access interface for shipper network model data.

governance.retention: life of planning engagement plus 36 months
governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to the owning shipper and planning teams

assets.name: Market Rate Signal
assets.description: Benchmarked spot and contract rate observations per lane, equipment, and time window, from internal and external sources.
assets.accessScope: rate intelligence, quoting, tendering, and procurement analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Market truth used to price quotes, benchmark contracts, and detect rate drift.

interfaces.name: market-rate-signal api
interfaces.description: Access interface for market rate signal data.

governance.sharingPolicy: aggregated signals shared internally; raw sources restricted by license

assets.name: Quote Record
assets.description: Spot quotes issued to shippers with lane, equipment, price components, validity window, and win/loss outcome.
assets.accessScope: spot quoting, pricing analytics, and sales workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Commercial record of priced demand and quote conversion performance.

interfaces.name: quote-record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for quote record data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to pricing, sales, and finance workflows

assets.name: Load Offer
assets.description: Loads offered to carriers with offered price, response, counter-offers, and booking outcome.
assets.accessScope: load boards, carrier app, matching, and booking workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Record of capacity demand meeting supply; source of acceptance and pricing behavior.

interfaces.name: load-offer api
interfaces.description: Access interface for load offer data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to marketplace, pricing, and the offered carrier

assets.name: Tender Event
assets.description: Tender offers, acceptances, rejections, and expirations flowing through routing guides and broadcast waterfalls.
assets.accessScope: tendering, routing-guide analytics, and operations
assets.businessMeaning: Execution trail of how loads move through the routing guide toward coverage.

interfaces.name: tender-event api
interfaces.description: Access interface for tender event data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to shipper, procurement, and operations workflows

assets.name: Capacity Commitment
assets.description: Committed drop-trailer pools, dedicated capacity agreements, and their utilization against plan.
assets.accessScope: dedicated capacity programs and network planning
assets.businessMeaning: Contractual capacity supply that planning and tendering can rely on before spot coverage.

interfaces.name: capacity-commitment api
interfaces.description: Access interface for capacity commitment data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to the committing parties and planning teams

subGroups.name: Financial Records
subGroups.description: Commercial, payment, billing, ledger, and settlement records.

assets.name: Freight Invoice
assets.description: Carrier invoices, shipper bills, accessorials, fuel, detention, taxes, accruals, audit results, disputes, and allocation references.
assets.accessScope: freight audit, payment, billing, claims, finance, and reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Financial record connecting operational shipment facts to payable, receivable, and accrual workflows.

interfaces.name: freight-invoice api
interfaces.description: Access interface for invoice and audit state.

governance.sharingPolicy: finance and account-permission controlled

assets.name: Settlement Record
assets.description: Carrier payables and shipper receivables per shipment: charges, adjustments, claims, payment status, and disputes.
assets.accessScope: settlement, payments, claims, and finance reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Financial truth of what is owed, paid, and disputed for every shipment.

interfaces.name: settlement-record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for settlement record data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to finance, audit, and the settled counterparties

assets.name: Financial Rule
assets.description: Configured fuel surcharge tables, accessorial tariffs, and detention rules applied to rating and settlement.
assets.accessScope: rating, invoicing, and settlement engines
assets.businessMeaning: Governs how fuel, accessorials, and detention convert operational facts into charges.

interfaces.name: financial-rule api
interfaces.description: Access interface for financial rule data.

governance.sharingPolicy: readable by rating and settlement workflows; changes controlled by finance

assets.name: Risk Signal
assets.description: Identity, fraud, double-brokering, and compliance risk indicators attached to carriers, users, and transactions.
assets.accessScope: risk scoring, onboarding, and payment-release decisions
assets.businessMeaning: Early-warning layer that protects the marketplace from fraud and compliance failures.

interfaces.name: risk-signal api
interfaces.description: Access interface for risk signal data.

governance.retention: per fraud and compliance retention obligations
governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to risk, compliance, and audit workflows

rootGroups.name: Operational Workflow and Event Data
rootGroups.description: Orders, bookings, trips, tasks, incidents, service requests, workflow states, and operational events used to run the domain.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Shipment Record
assets.description: Canonical shipment, load, stop, tender, carrier, appointment, visibility, document, cost, and settlement references.
assets.accessScope: TMS, tendering, visibility, operations, audit, settlement, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Central business object connecting demand, carrier supply, execution, documents, and finance.

interfaces.name: shipment api
interfaces.description: Canonical shipment lifecycle interface.

governance.retention: commercial and tax retention by market
governance.sharingPolicy: customer-visible shipment data controlled by account permissions

assets.name: Appointment Record
assets.description: Dock and yard appointments with requested, scheduled, and actual times plus reschedule history.
assets.accessScope: appointment scheduling, tracking, and facility workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Coordination record aligning carriers, facilities, and shipments to time slots.

interfaces.name: appointment-record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for appointment record data.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared across shipper, carrier, and facility workflows

assets.name: Operations Case
assets.description: Control-tower cases for at-risk shipments: issue type, owner, actions taken, and resolution outcome.
assets.accessScope: operations control tower and exception workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Working record of human and automated intervention on problem shipments.

interfaces.name: operations-case api
interfaces.description: Access interface for operations case data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to operations, support, and affected counterparties

assets.name: Freight Document
assets.description: Captured and validated BOLs, PODs, lumper receipts, and invoices with extraction results and validation status.
assets.accessScope: document capture, settlement, and claims workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Documentary evidence that shipments happened as billed; gate for clean settlement.

interfaces.name: freight-document api
interfaces.description: Access interface for freight document data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to settlement, claims, audit, and the document parties

assets.name: Communication Thread
assets.description: Threaded customer and carrier communications (email, chat, SMS) linked to shipments, cases, and accounts.
assets.accessScope: communications hub, operations, and support workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Context trail of commitments and instructions exchanged around each shipment.

interfaces.name: communication-thread api
interfaces.description: Access interface for communication thread data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to thread participants, operations, and support

subGroups.name: Events and Logs
subGroups.description: Append-only events, logs, state changes, and operational traces.

assets.name: Visibility Event
assets.description: Location, milestone, geofence, ETA, tracking source, appointment, arrival, departure, and dwell events.
assets.accessScope: visibility, exception management, analytics, and customer status updates
assets.businessMeaning: Operational signal set used to predict risk, report status, and measure service quality.

interfaces.name: visibility api
interfaces.description: Access interface for shipment milestones and ETA.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared only for shipment execution, customer visibility, and compliance-approved analytics

assets.name: Tracking Event
assets.description: Carrier check calls, ELD pings, and app locations normalized into shipment tracking updates.
assets.accessScope: tracking, visibility, ETA, and exception detection
assets.businessMeaning: Raw movement truth behind ETAs, dwell intelligence, and exception triggers.

interfaces.name: tracking-event api
interfaces.description: Access interface for tracking event data.

governance.sharingPolicy: location detail restricted; derived status shared with shipment parties

assets.name: Exception Event
assets.description: Detected shipment exceptions (late, OS&D, no-show, breakdown) with severity, detection source, and lifecycle state.
assets.accessScope: exception workbench, control tower, and automation
assets.businessMeaning: Trigger stream that turns operational anomalies into managed work.

interfaces.name: exception-event api
interfaces.description: Access interface for exception event data.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared with operations and affected shipment parties

assets.name: Integration Event
assets.description: EDI/API messages exchanged with customer and carrier systems, with delivery status and error detail.
assets.accessScope: integration gateway, onboarding, and support diagnostics
assets.businessMeaning: Audit trail of machine-to-machine exchanges and integration health.

interfaces.name: integration-event api
interfaces.description: Access interface for integration event data.

governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to integration, support, and the exchanging parties

assets.name: Automation Run
assets.description: Executions of workflow automations and agents: trigger, decisions taken, actions performed, and outcome.
assets.accessScope: automation platform, operations review, and governance
assets.businessMeaning: Accountability record for what automation did on whose behalf and why.

interfaces.name: automation-run api
interfaces.description: Access interface for automation run data.

governance.sharingPolicy: readable by operations and automation governance

assets.name: Freight Event
assets.description: Canonical domain event stream unifying shipment, tender, tracking, and settlement events for the data platform.
assets.accessScope: data platform, analytics, and downstream consumers
assets.businessMeaning: Single normalized event backbone that analytics and ML build on.

interfaces.name: freight-event api
interfaces.description: Access interface for freight event data.

governance.sharingPolicy: governed consumption via data platform contracts

rootGroups.name: Analytics, Intelligence, and Sustainability Data
rootGroups.description: Derived datasets, features, metrics, and sustainability records built on the operational and commercial assets.

assets.name: Matching Feature Set
assets.description: Engineered features for carrier-load matching: lane affinity, acceptance propensity, price sensitivity, and recency signals.
assets.accessScope: matching engine training and online scoring
assets.businessMeaning: Feature layer that determines match quality and offer targeting.

interfaces.name: matching-feature api
interfaces.description: Access interface for matching feature set data.

governance.sharingPolicy: internal to matching and data-science workflows

assets.name: Performance Metric
assets.description: Curated KPI aggregates for shippers, carriers, lanes, and teams: OTP, tender acceptance, cost, and quality trends.
assets.accessScope: analytics, scorecards, QBRs, and executive reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Agreed performance truth used in reviews and continuous improvement.

interfaces.name: performance-metric api
interfaces.description: Access interface for performance metric data.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared per counterparty scope; internal rollups restricted

assets.name: Decision Experiment
assets.description: Registered experiments on pricing, matching, and automation policies with hypothesis, variants, and measured results.
assets.accessScope: experimentation platform and decision governance
assets.businessMeaning: Governance record connecting algorithmic changes to measured outcomes.

interfaces.name: decision-experiment api
interfaces.description: Access interface for decision experiment data.

governance.sharingPolicy: internal to product, data science, and governance

assets.name: Emissions Record
assets.description: Shipment-level CO2e estimates by mode, distance, and fuel factors, aggregated for customer sustainability reporting.
assets.accessScope: sustainability insights and customer ESG reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Auditable emissions basis for carbon-aware planning and disclosures.

interfaces.name: emissions-record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for emissions record data.

governance.sharingPolicy: shared with the owning shipper and regulators as required
